packageRules.description: Wait a week before proposing a newly published version. Most compromised releases are found and pulled within a day or two, and the window costs nothing here — nothing in this workspace needs a package the day it ships. Repeated on every rule below because a later rule that matches the same package would otherwise drop the wait without saying so.
Nx packages are upgraded through `nx migrate`, which also runs code migrations. Renovate bumping them alone would skip those.
NestJS majors are pinned to the line supported by the installed @nx/nest generators.
Group lint/format tooling so one PR covers the whole toolchain.
